Name: no_exact_parameter_verification
Statement: Finite data cannot uniquely verify an exact continuous parameter under strict compatibility and continuity.

Name: measurement_discriminates
Statement: Predictions separated by more than twice the error bar cannot both fit one measurement.

Name: falsification_by_measurement
Statement: The finite-precision compatibility predicate is non-vacuous; some observations refute a parameter.

Name: le_phaseSpeed
Statement: Under c>0 and alpha^2<1, EFMW phase speed is at least c.

Name: lt_phaseSpeed
Statement: For nonzero alpha with alpha^2<1, EFMW phase speed is strictly greater than c.

Name: alpha_sq_le_of_speed_measurement
Statement: A null speed measurement yields an explicit upper bound on alpha^2.

Name: alpha_eq_zero_of_exact_lightspeed
Statement: Exact luminal phase speed forces alpha=0 under the model assumptions.

Name: phaseSpeed_gap
Statement: A coupling bounded away from zero implies a definite phase-speed gap from c.

Name: speed_experiment_discriminates
Statement: Sufficient precision separates alpha=0 from |alpha|>=epsilon.

Name: decisive_precision_exists
Statement: A finite positive precision exists that can discriminate the separated scalar hypotheses.

Name: OmegaU_sq_le_of_hubble_measurement
Statement: A null Hubble-rate result bounds Omega_U^2 <= delta a^2.

Name: OmegaU_eq_zero_of_exact_hubble
Statement: Exact agreement with baseline Friedmann expansion forces Omega_U=0 in the formalized model.

Name: physical_test_asymmetry
Statement: Finite-precision experiments can refute/bound but cannot uniquely verify exact continuous parameters.

Name: gradient_bridge
Statement: If dD=dU-lambda dR then -dD=-dU+lambda dR.

Name: approximate_gradient_bridge
Statement: Bridge mismatch equals the explicit residual -epsilon dQ.

Name: discrete_fixed_point
Statement: The ME-072-style affine update fixes x when target=beta*x.

Name: perturbation_propagation
Statement: Affine perturbations propagate by multiplier (1-alpha*beta).

Name: alarm_translation_invariant
Statement: Equal shifts of signal and threshold preserve alarm truth value.

Name: equal_score_not_state_equality
Statement: Equal scalarized scores need not imply equal underlying states.

Name: omega_zero_regularizers
Statement: Collapse-Omega objective reduces to base loss when regularizers are zero.

Name: phaseSpeed_neg
Statement: Scalar phase speed is invariant under alpha -> -alpha; speed identifies |alpha|, not sign.

Name: real_wave_admissibility
Statement: A nontrivial real plane-wave dispersion solution requires alpha^2<1.

Name: phaseSpeed_inversion
Statement: Exact model speed v implies alpha^2 = 1-(c/v)^2.

Name: friedmann_rotation_sign_degeneracy
Statement: The Friedmann prediction is invariant under Omega_U -> -Omega_U.

Name: friedmann_rotation_curvature_degeneracy
Statement: Constant residual rotation is exactly degenerate with k_eff=k-Omega_U^2 in the current Friedmann expression.
